main_text.head: CAP. I

p.i: Aufer legales scrupulos. lex nulla bonis est.
Fers mihi in exemplar, Christe redemtor, opem.
Belle pro cunctis orandum. unus mediator.
Vir mulierque rogent, sit tamen illa silens.
Curet Episcopus hæc, curent hæc iussa ministri.
Si tarde veniam, sic rege tecta Dei.
Ficta valere sinas, quæque iubemus age.
Elige sic viduas duplici digneris honore.
Falsi loquos vita, laqueos fuge divitiarum.

main_text.head: Breuissimè.

p.i: Fabulæ, Adam, Domui, Pietas, Viduas, Oriuntur.

main_text.head: Declaratio.
main_text.p: Fabulæ non sectandæ: v. 4. Adam prior formatus est, deinde Eua: v. 13. Domui suæ qui bene præsit eligendus est Episcopus: v. 4. Pietas ad omnia utilis est: v. 8. Viduas honora quæ verè viduæ sunt: v. 3. Oriuntur ex verborum pugna lites, suspiciones malæ &c: v. 4.
main_text.head: II EPISTOLA AD TIMOTHEUM.
main_text.p: OCCASIO huius secundæ ad Timotheum Epistolæ commodè sumi potest ex i-plo exordio, ex quo constat quod Timotheus Apostolum Paulum in vltimo digressu dimiserit multis lacrymis. Hunc dolorem in discipulo vt leniret, promisit illi in 1. Epist.; cap. 3. v. 14.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan shows part of the neighbouring page, not transcribed. The printed text uses long s, read as plain s throughout. Doubtful readings: "loquos" (v. 6 of the verse, possibly a misprint for loquax), "i-plo" (line-end word, probably ipso), "Epist.;" (punctuation uncertain), page number "233" and catchword "suu" are uncertain. The verse numbers 2 to 6 are printed in the left margin beside the verse stanzas. The initial "A" and "O" are large initials joined to their words. Verse in the first stanza uses printed "scrupulos. lex" with the period as printed.
